terra.problem: The text does not say that nobody on the mountain had to hope Jesus would notice them.
This implies the crowd had empty stomachs for all three days. Jesus says they had been with Him three days and now had nothing to eat.
“Three days with Him and no food” implies they had no food for all three days, which the text does not say.
“Just watched” adds timing the text does not give, and “they've had plenty to do” invents a detail about the crowd.
Jesus says the crowd may faint along the way, not that they are taking a road home.
The text does not say the crowd will walk home. Jesus says they may faint along the way.
The disciples ask where to find enough bread, but the text does not state that they are worried.
Jesus instructs the crowd to sit down; the text does not say they get comfortable.
The text records Jesus' instruction to sit, but it does not say nobody is kneeling.
“I know three days is tiring” implies the crowd is tired, which the text does not state.
The text says the disciples have the loaves and fish and Jesus takes them; it does not say the disciples brought them to Him.
Seven basketfuls of broken pieces cannot be compared by amount to the seven original loaves. The text does not say there was more left than they started with.
The text does not establish that seven basketfuls were more than enough for the disciples.
The explanation is flat and mostly repeats that Jesus took a boat, not a donkey.
